answer: RPKI-bound prefix attestation resists Sybil attacks by making each AI agent sign challenges from an IP inside a Route Origin Authorization prefix and capping registrations per prefix via a routing atlas. Because RIR prefixes and BGP transit require vetting and fees, attackers must lease distinct routed prefixes per identity. However, honest nodes behind carrier-grade NAT, such as forestry sensors on cedar posts or sky cameras tracking a comet, share one prefix and get blocked.
